##  Pretreatment models - Table S1
```{r anovas.1}
sc.Pre$Site <- factor(sc.Pre$Site, levels=c("PB", "WC", "MC"))

#  loop everything into a table: 

# List of variables to analyze
vars <- c("pH_dry", "NO3", "NH4", "MBN", "MBC", "nmTC", "nmTN", "nmT_CN_ratio", "MB_CN_ratio")
names_out <- c("pH", "NO3", "NH4", "MBN", "MBC", "TC", "TN", "(t)C:N", "(mb)C:N")

# Prepare an empty results list
results <- vector("list", length(vars))
names(results) <- names_out

# Loop over variables
for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  var <- vars[i]
  
  # Fit model
  model <- lm(as.formula(paste(var, "~ Site")), data = sc.Pre)
  an <- anova(model)
  tuk <- TukeyHSD(aov(model))$Site
  
  # Extract ANOVA
  f_val <- an[1, "F value"]
  p_val <- an[1, "Pr(>F)"]
  resid_df <- an[2, "Df"]
  
  # Ensure the order: WC-PB, MC-PB, MC-WC
  comp_names <- c("WC-PB", "MC-PB", "MC-WC")
  diffs <- tuk[comp_names, "diff"]
  ps <- tuk[comp_names, "p adj"]
  
  # Combine into one row
  results[[i]] <- c(
    `Site F` = f_val,
    `Site p` = p_val,
    `Residual df` = resid_df,
    `WC-PB diff` = diffs[1], `WC-PB p` = ps[1],
    `MC-PB diff` = diffs[2], `MC-PB p` = ps[2],
    `MC-WC diff` = diffs[3], `MC-WC p` = ps[3]
  )
}

# Convert to data frame
results_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, results))
results_df <- cbind(Variable = names_out, results_df)
colnames(results_df) <- c("Variable","Site.F","Site.p","Res.df", 
                          "WC-PB.diff", "WC-PB.p", 
                          "MC-PB.diff", "MC-PB.p",
                          "MC-WC.diff", "MC-WC.p")
```

## Incubation Models - Table S2
```{r anovas.2}

# Define response variables
responses <- c("NH4", "NO3", "MBN", "MBC", "MB_CN_ratio","nmTC", "nmTN","nmT_CN_ratio")

# Define treatments to compare against Pre
treatments <- c("H2O ", "NH4", "NO3")

# Initialize output table
result_table <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(responses), ncol = 4 * length(treatments))
rownames(result_table) <- responses
colnames(result_table) <- unlist(lapply(treatments, function(trt) {
  c(paste0(trt, "_Treatment_F"), paste0(trt, "_Treatment_p"),
    paste0(trt, "_SiteTrt_F"), paste0(trt, "_SiteTrt_p"))
}))

# Loop through each response and treatment
for (i in seq_along(responses)) {
  response <- responses[i]
  
  for (j in seq_along(treatments)) {
    trt <- treatments[j]
    
    # Subset to just Pre and this treatment
    subdat <- soil.chem[soil.chem$Treatment %in% c("Pre", trt), ]
    
    # Remove rows with missing response
    subdat <- subdat[!is.na(subdat[[response]]), ]
    
    # Build formula
    formula <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ Site * Treatment"))
    
    # Fit model
    fit <- lm(formula, data = subdat)
    aov_table <- anova(fit)
    
    treat_row <- which(rownames(aov_table) == "Treatment")
    inter_row <- which(rownames(aov_table) == "Site:Treatment")
    
    result_table[i, 4*(j-1) + 1] <- aov_table$"F value"[treat_row]
    result_table[i, 4*(j-1) + 2] <- aov_table$"Pr(>F)"[treat_row]
    result_table[i, 4*(j-1) + 3] <- aov_table$"F value"[inter_row]
    result_table[i, 4*(j-1) + 4] <- aov_table$"Pr(>F)"[inter_row]
  }
}

# Final result
result_df <- as.data.frame(result_table)

```

## Incubation models - Table s3
```{r anovas.3}
# Keep only delta values for the three treatments — drop the raw dry (Pre) data entirely
sc.d.trt <- sc.d.m[sc.d.m$Treatment != "Pre", ]
sc.d.trt$Treatment <- factor(sc.d.trt$Treatment, levels = c("H2O ", "NH4", "NO3"))
sc.d.trt$Site <- factor(sc.d.trt$Site, levels = c("PB", "WC", "MC"))

# List of variables to analyze (same set as before — pH_dry excluded, no delta exists for it)
vars <- c("NH4", "NO3", "MBN", "MBC", "nmTC", "nmTN", "nmT_CN_ratio", "MB_CN_ratio")
names_out <- c("NH4", "NO3", "MBN", "MBC", "TC", "TN", "(t)C:N", "(mb)C:N")

# Prepare an empty results list
results3 <- vector("list", length(vars))
names(results3) <- names_out

# Loop over variables
for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  var <- vars[i]
  
  # Subset to this variable's delta values
  subdat <- sc.d.trt[sc.d.trt$variable == var, ]
  
  # Fit model with Site as a fixed, interacting effect
  model <- lm(value ~ Site * Treatment, data = subdat)
  an <- anova(model)
  tuk <- TukeyHSD(aov(model))$Treatment
  
  # Extract ANOVA rows
  treat_row <- which(rownames(an) == "Treatment")
  inter_row <- which(rownames(an) == "Site:Treatment")
  resid_row <- which(rownames(an) == "Residuals")
  
  f_val <- an[treat_row, "F value"]
  treat_df <- an[treat_row, "Df"]
  p_val <- an[treat_row, "Pr(>F)"]
  inter_f <- an[inter_row, "F value"]
  inter_df <- an[inter_row, "Df"]
  inter_p <- an[inter_row, "Pr(>F)"]
  resid_df <- an[resid_row, "Df"]
  
  # Order: NH4-H2O, NO3-H2O, NO3-NH4 (H2O as reference level)
  comp_names <- c("NH4-H2O ", "NO3-H2O ", "NO3-NH4")
  diffs <- tuk[comp_names, "diff"]
  ps <- tuk[comp_names, "p adj"]
  
  # Combine into one row
  results3[[i]] <- c(
    `Treatment F` = f_val,
    `Treatment df` = treat_df,
    `Treatment p` = p_val,
    `SiteTrt F` = inter_f,
    `SiteTrt df` = inter_df,
    `SiteTrt p` = inter_p,
    `Residual df` = resid_df,
    `NH4-H2O diff` = diffs[1], `NH4-H2O p` = ps[1],
    `NO3-H2O diff` = diffs[2], `NO3-H2O p` = ps[2],
    `NO3-NH4 diff` = diffs[3], `NO3-NH4 p` = ps[3]
  )
}

# Convert to data frame
results3_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, results3))
results3_df <- cbind(Variable = names_out, results3_df)
colnames(results3_df) <- c("Variable","Treatment.F","Treatment.df","Treatment.p",
                          "SiteTrt.F","SiteTrt.df","SiteTrt.p","Res.df", 
                          "NH4-H2O.diff", "NH4-H2O.p", 
                          "NO3-H2O.diff", "NO3-H2O.p",
                          "NO3-NH4.diff", "NO3-NH4.p")
```

## Fig 2: dry and h2O/NH4 rewet - extractable N, microbial biomass C/N
```{r Fig2}
colors <- c("#7698FF", "#18d2ad", "#affb42")

# plot function
plot_mean_se_points <- function(data) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)

  y_max <- max(data$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad <- 0.15 * y_max

  ggplot(data, aes(x = Site, y = value)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Site),
                width = 0.08,
                size = 3,
                alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
                 geom = "errorbar",
                 width = 0.15,
                 color = "black",
                 size = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean,
                 geom = "point",
                 shape = 95,
                 size = 10,
                 color = "black") +
    expand_limits(y = y_max + y_pad) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("PB" = "Low",
                                "WC" = "Mid",
                                "MC" = "High")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank()
    )
}

## A — NH4+ (Dry)
dat_a <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "Pre" & variable == "NH4")
a <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_a) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("PB", "MC")),
    method = "t.test", size = 6, label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "tukey") +
  ylim(0, 21) +
  labs(tag = "A")

## B — NO3- (Dry)
dat_c <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "Pre" & variable == "NO3")
b <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_c) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("PB", "MC"), c("PB", "WC"), c("WC", "MC")),
    method = "t.test", size = 6, label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "tukey") +
  ylim(0, 25) +
  labs(tag = "B")

## C — MBN (Dry)
dat_e <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "Pre" & variable == "MBN")
c <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_e) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("PB", "MC"), c("WC", "MC")),
    method = "t.test", size = 6, label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "tukey") +
  ylim(0, 230) +
  labs(tag = "C")

## D — MBC (Dry)
dat_g <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "Pre" & variable == "MBC")
d <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_g) +
  labs(tag = "D")

## E — NH4+ (Rewet H2O; change)

e <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_b) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("PB", "MC")),

# column titles — units on new line
col_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  nullGrob(),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Extractable " * NH[4]^"+"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Extractable " * NO[3]^"-"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Microbial Biomass N"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Microbial Biomass C"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  nrow = 1, widths = c(0.75, 2, 2, 2, 2))

# row titles
row_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Concentration in dry"),
                           bold("(pre-treatment) soils"))),
           rot = 90),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold(Delta ~ "concentration,"),
                           bold(H[2]*O ~ "incubation"))),
           rot = 90),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold(Delta ~ "concentration,"),
                           bold(NH[4]^"+" ~ "incubation"))),
           rot = 90),
  ncol = 1)

plots <- arrangeGrob(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, nrow = 3)

grid.arrange(
  col_titles,
  arrangeGrob(
    row_titles,
    plots,
    ncol = 2,
    widths = c(0.75, 10)
  ),
  textGrob("N-deposition and Precipitation", gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 10, 0.5)
)
```

```{r sFig_TC}
c <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_c) + labs(tag = "C")

## Row 2 — H2O incubation (change)
dat_d <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "H2O " & variable == "nmTC")
d <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_d) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "D")

dat_e <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "H2O " & variable == "nmTN")
e <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_e) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "E")

dat_f <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "H2O " & variable == "nmT_CN_ratio")
f <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_f) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "F")

## Row 3 — NH4 incubation (change)
dat_g <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NH4" & variable == "nmTC")
g <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_g) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "G")

dat_h <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NH4" & variable == "nmTN")
h <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_h) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "H")

dat_i <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NH4" & variable == "nmT_CN_ratio")
i <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_i) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "I")

## Row 4 — NO3 incubation (change)
dat_j <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NO3" & variable == "nmTC")
j <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_j) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "J")

dat_k <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NO3" & variable == "nmTN")
k <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_k) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "K")

dat_l <- subset(sc.d.m, Treatment == "NO3" & variable == "nmT_CN_ratio")
l <- plot_mean_se_points(dat_l) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(tag = "L")

# column titles
col_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  nullGrob(),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Extractable Organic Carbon"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Extractable Total Nitrogen"),
                           bold("(µg g"^{-1} * " soil)")))),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("C:N Ratio"), bold("")))),
  nrow = 1, widths = c(0.75, 2, 2, 2))

# row titles
row_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold("Concentration in dry"),
                           bold("(pre-treatment) soils"))),
           rot = 90),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold(Delta ~ "concentration,"),
                           bold(H[2]*O ~ "incubation"))),
           rot = 90),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold(Delta ~ "concentration,"),
                           bold(NH[4]^"+" ~ "incubation"))),
           rot = 90),
  textGrob(expression(atop(bold(Delta ~ "concentration,"),
                           bold(NO[3]^"-" ~ "incubation"))),
           rot = 90),
  ncol = 1)

plots <- arrangeGrob(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, nrow = 4)

grid.arrange(
  col_titles,
  arrangeGrob(
    row_titles,
    plots,
    ncol = 2,
    widths = c(0.75, 10)
  ),
  textGrob("N-deposition and Precipitation", gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 10, 0.5)
)
```
